name: 7 Wonders Duel
description: 7 Wonders Duel is a two-player commercial card-drafting strategy game where players take visible and hidden cards from a shared structure to build civilizations.

content.text: 7 Wonders Duel is a two-player commercial card-drafting strategy game where players take visible and hidden cards from a shared structure to build civilizations.
7 Wonders Duel was designed by Antoine Bauza and Bruno Cathala as a dedicated two-player reworking of the 7 Wonders card-drafting system.
Two players face a shared card structure and personal civilization area.
Use the dedicated Age decks, guild cards, wonder cards, tokens, and military/science tracks.
Dedicated civilization cards, guild cards, wonder cards, science tokens, and military track, score area, and enough table space for play.
Lay out the current Age in its prescribed overlapping structure, with some cards face down and some cards face up.
